import unittest

from solution import MessageBuffer


class MessageBufferTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_claim_moves_only_requested_oldest_messages(self):
        buffer = MessageBuffer()
        buffer.add("one", {"value": 1})
        buffer.add("two", {"value": 2})
        buffer.add("three", {"value": 3})

        self.assertEqual(
            buffer.claim(2),
            [("one", {"value": 1}), ("two", {"value": 2})],
        )
        self.assertEqual(buffer.pending_count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(buffer.inflight_count(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(buffer.claim(5), [("three", {"value": 3})])
        self.assertEqual(buffer.pending_count(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(buffer.inflight_count(), 3)
        self.assertEqual(buffer.claim(1), [])

    def test_inflight_messages_are_not_claimed_again(self):
        buffer = MessageBuffer()
        buffer.add("a", 1)
        buffer.add("b", 2)
        self.assertEqual(buffer.claim(1), [("a", 1)])
        self.assertEqual(buffer.claim(1), [("b", 2)])
        self.assertEqual(buffer.claim(1), [])

    def test_duplicate_pending_or_inflight_id_is_rejected(self):
        buffer = MessageBuffer()
        buffer.add("id", {"x": 1})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            buffer.add("id", {"x": 2})
        buffer.claim(1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            buffer.add("id", {"x": 3})

    def test_acknowledge_only_removes_matching_inflight(self):
        buffer = MessageBuffer()
        for message_id in ("a", "b", "c"):
            buffer.add(message_id, message_id)
        buffer.claim(2)
        buffer.acknowledge(["a", "unknown", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(buffer.inflight_count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(buffer.pending_count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(buffer.claim(1), [("c", "c")])

    def test_acknowledged_identifier_can_be_added_again(self):
        buffer = MessageBuffer()
        buffer.add("id", 1)
        buffer.claim(1)
        buffer.acknowledge(["id"])
        buffer.add("id", 2)
        self.assertEqual(buffer.claim(1), [("id", 2)])

    def test_payload_is_deep_copied_on_add_and_claim(self):
        payload = {"nested": [1]}
        buffer = MessageBuffer()
        buffer.add("id", payload)
        payload["nested"].append(2)

        claimed = buffer.claim(1)
        self.assertEqual(claimed, [("id", {"nested": [1]})])
        claimed[0][1]["nested"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(buffer.inflight_count(), 1)
        buffer.acknowledge(["id"])
        self.assertEqual(buffer.inflight_count(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(payload, {"nested": [1, 2]})

    def test_limit_validation(self):
        buffer = MessageBuffer()
        for limit in (True, False, 1.0, "1", None):
            with self.subTest(limit=limit):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    buffer.claim(limit)
        for limit in (0, -1):
            with self.subTest(limit=limit):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    buffer.claim(limit)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
